spec_references: ## Operators: Unary operators — logical `!`; numeric ops `+`, `-`; bitwise complement `~`
## Expressions: Literal — Currently support `nil-literal`, `boolean-literal`, `numeric-literal` and `string-literal` only
reason: Unary logical, numeric and complement operations are explicitly supported, including the nil-lifted expressions used with nullable operands. Integer subtypes and diagnostic toString method calls are explicitly allowed. Numeric literals, user-defined types, tuple/list construction and indexing, type tests, equality, calls, returns and panic are covered by the positive lists; no applicable restriction excludes the asserted numeric values or unary-plus subtype preservation. The output markers assert ordinary supported unary results; io:println is instrumentation.
test_design_notes: Mixed coverage spans primitive, subtype, union, singleton-alias and nullable unary operations, all within supported scope.
Copy/paste coverage gaps: testComplementOperator computes b3 and b4 from a2 instead of a3/a4; testUnaryOperationsWithIntSubtypes computes y5 from x6 instead of x11.
Only the initial primitive results have @output markers; subsequent coverage relies on assertEquality panicking on failure.
